visual_argument: A fair test drawn as an apparatus: two matched halves with one tool switched off, and Kang's three questions built as three measuring instruments shown at rest before anything is measured, so no frame can imply a result.
build_risk: Frame 7 must read as three handoff trays with every shuttle parked on the clinician's side in one second at feed size, without implying the clinicians hand off nothing. Frame 1 is a cutaway with two rooms, two actors and two clinicians that can turn into a busy dollhouse, and kit people are the deck's named risk.
